summary: Dedicated endpoint ignoring model pin; unexpected fallback to variant after rollout
description:
Deployment mode: Dedicated.

Issue summary:
Customer reports response quality regression starting after they enabled a canary rollout in Console. They expected the Dedicated endpoint to remain pinned to rw-chat-3.2 (full precision), but traces show requests served by rw-chat-3.2-quant (fallback variant) for ~30% of traffic.

Impact:
- Quality complaints from their end users
- No elevated error rate; issue is correctness/consistency

Steps/observations:
- Customer has model pin set at endpoint level
- Console rollout UI shows pin applied, but routing policy includes 'fallback_on_capacity=true'
- In Dedicated, fallback should not switch to a different quant profile unless explicitly allowed.

Ask:
Identify how quant variant became eligible and prevent automatic switching.
comments: 2026-02-02 18:02 UTC (Ben Carter): Confirmed with customer: they did not opt into quantization; they only enabled canary percent on same model version.
2026-02-03 00:20 UTC (Maya Srinivasan): Found registry metadata bug: quant variant incorrectly marked as 'compatible_fallback=true' for this endpoint's policy template.
2026-02-03 01:05 UTC (Maya Srinivasan): Temporarily disabled fallback to quant variants for this customer by overriding routing policy.
2026-02-03 02:10 UTC (Ben Carter): Customer confirms quality back to baseline.
2026-02-04 19:30 UTC (Maya Srinivasan): PR 311 fixes compatibility flag generation + adds unit test for Dedicated pinning semantics.
2026-02-05 09:12 UTC (Ben Carter): Fix deployed; removed override; monitoring.
resolution: Patched model-registry compatibility flags so Dedicated model pinning cannot fall back to quant variants unless explicitly enabled. Deployed fix and verified routing.
workaround: Support can temporarily override routing policy to disable variant fallback while investigating.
root_cause: Model-registry bug incorrectly set quant variant as eligible fallback in policy template used by Dedicated endpoints.
follow_ups: Add UI copy clarifying what fallback may switch to
Create regression test that simulates Dedicated pin + rollout
Audit existing policy templates for 'compatible_fallback' misuse
